issues.explanation: $fillable is empty so EntityInvite::create throws MassAssignmentException and no model hook lowercases/trims email as required.
Pending-invite check ignores expiry so expired invites cannot be replaced as required.
Reset uses non-existent key email so inviteEmail is never cleared after sending.
No rate limiting of successful invites (10 per hour) is implemented anywhere in the diff.
accept() has only a TODO instead of setting the tenant session and redirecting to the entity dashboard.
accept() always creates a membership without preventing duplicates and marks accepted_at before the write.
Mailable does not implement ShouldQueue and uses build() instead of the required content()->markdown contract.
Invite email view omits the required Access the link below instruction line.
Pending-invites view is a placeholder with no title, Accept/Decline buttons, hr logic, nor switcher/onboarding integration.
assignRole one-click role change is kept and openMember/saveRole/confirmRemoval/cancelRemoval/removeMember modal flow plus manager-only mount and route guard are missing.
Factory has no namespace, defaults entity_id to null instead of an entity, and adds a non-contract forEntity helper.
Members mount has no owner/admin 403 check and PendingInvites uses abort_if on an unscoped lookup instead of policies with no rate limit or duplicate guard.
The diff ships no Pest/PHPUnit tests, including the required unauthorized-call and tamper tests for Livewire actions.
Domain writes go directly through Eloquent instead of app/Actions and authorization bypasses policies in PendingInvites with no docs update.
Leftover assignRole, TODO comment, unused BelongsToMany/User imports, and missing trailing newline hurt maintainability.
All touched files serve the invite task with no unrelated refactors, despite omissions.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/PendingInvites.php:28 abort_if instead of $this->authorize policy; app/Models/EntityInvite.php:31-39 broken $fillable; database/factories/EntityInviteFactory.php:1 missing namespace; no app/Actions, no docs sync

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/PendingInvites.php:146 TODO: set tenant session and redirect; app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:105 leftover assignRole; app/Models/EntityInvite.php:25 unused BelongsToMany; emails/entity-invite.blade.php:19 no newline

requirements.evidence: app/Models/EntityInvite.php:31-39 $fillable=[] blocks create and no lowercase/trim hook; app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:53-57 pending check omits expiry + :93 reset('email'); app/Livewire/Entity/PendingInvites.php:146 TODO no session/redirect; pending-invites.blade.php:1 placeholder; no openMember/saveRole/rate-limit/content()

scope.evidence: change.diff:1-427 only invite/members/email/lang/migration/factory files, no unrelated features

security.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:33-38 mount without 403, :96-101 cancelInvite scoped ok; app/Livewire/Entity/PendingInvites.php:26 unscoped findOrFail + abort_if, :137-141 duplicate membership possible; no RateLimiter anywhere

simplicity.evidence: Reuses audit Log channel, Mail::queue, existing validation attributes; extra forEntity() helper and owner in migration enum add slight indirection

tests.evidence: change.diff:1-427 contains no tests/ directory changes and no Pest cases for happy/validation/unauthorized/tamper paths

review.summary: The change starts the invite flow (table, mailable, send/cancel/accept/decline shells) but cannot work as written due to empty $fillable, and omits rate limiting, expiry-aware replacement, session/redirect, modals, manager-only guards, and all tests, needing substantial rework before merge.
